opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships

amount.raw: The scheme is covered under the Full Economic Costing (FEC) regime. Currently, the Academy funds 80 per cent of salary costs, directly allocated and indirect costs under FEC. Three year award.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early-career researchers in the humanities and social sciences based at an eligible UK university or recognised research organisation. Must have completed Viva Voce between 1 April 2024 and 1 April 2027; must not have been appointed to a permanent academic post.
opportunities.summary: A three-year postdoctoral fellowship for outstanding early-career researchers in the humanities or social sciences to pursue an independent research project towards a significant piece of publishable research.

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established researchers in the humanities and social sciences ordinarily resident in the UK, holding a current long-term appointment at a UK-based HEI or IRO. Independent researchers without institutional affiliation not eligible.
opportunities.summary: Awards to promote the acquisition and advancement of skills in relevant areas (e.g. quantitative skills, data science, digital humanities, languages) by UK-based researchers, supporting innovative research methods.

opportunities.title: APEX Awards

amount.raw: Applicants can apply for up to £200,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established independent researchers with a strong track record, holding a permanent or fixed-term position covering the award duration, based in a UK university or UK not-for-profit research organisation, with teaching and admin duties. Up to two Co-applicants from a different Academy remit.
opportunities.summary: Interdisciplinary, curiosity-driven research awards in partnership with the Royal Society and Royal Academy of Engineering (supported by Leverhulme Trust), promoting collaboration at the boundary between science, engineering, and the social sciences and humanities.

opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to any researcher based in the UK who meets the conditions of the call, across all career stages. Previous successful recipients not eligible to reapply.
opportunities.summary: Awards to support ambitious public engagement projects with the humanities and social sciences, working in partnership with a gallery, archive, library, museum (GLAM) or performing arts organisation.

opportunities.title: The Alexander von Humboldt Foundation and The British Academy Knowledge Frontiers Symposium 2027

amount.raw: The symposium covers travel, accommodation, and visa costs.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career researchers affiliated with research institutions in the UK or Germany, in the humanities and social sciences.
opportunities.summary: An invitation for early career scholars in the humanities and social sciences to attend a research collaboration symposium on the theme 'Humans and Nature: More resilient towards the future', with seed funding available for international collaborations.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027

amount.raw: Up to £300,000 over 2 years, offered at 80% FEC (total project value at 100% FEC may not exceed £375,000).

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Principal Investigator must be a researcher from the humanities and social sciences based at an eligible UK university or research institute with an established role lasting the award duration, postdoctoral or above. Involvement of overseas Co-Applicants required.
opportunities.summary: Supports UK-led international, genuinely interdisciplinary research projects on the theme of 'Mobilities', led by and grounded in the humanities and/or social sciences, collaborating across SHAPE and STEM disciplines.

opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships: The German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) 2026-27

amount.raw: Up to £150,000 for 12 months in duration (with Full Economic Costing at 80 per cent).

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based early- and mid-career researchers from across the humanities and social sciences.
opportunities.summary: Fellowships offering UK-based early- and mid-career researchers the opportunity to embed themselves in the office of the German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) in Berlin, developing skills, networks and careers in policy and other sectors.

opportunities.title: Additional Needs

amount.raw: Applicants may apply for funding of up to £4,000; exceptional cases above £4,000 considered.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current British Academy award-holders on any scheme, or applicants intending to apply for a British Academy award in the next six months who meet the eligibility requirements of that scheme.
opportunities.summary: Funding to support additional needs that applicants and award-holders may require (e.g. specific equipment, caring costs, assistance for sensory impairment, support in making an application), in addition to their research expenses.
